findings.message: `widgetViews` is declared but never initialised, so it is a nil map. The `widgetViews[id]++` on line 65 panics on the first request to `viewWidget`.

net/http runs handlers concurrently, so unsynchronised writes to the shared package-level map are a data race. Concurrent map writes make the Go runtime abort the whole process with a fatal error. Guard the map with a `sync.Mutex` (ideally a field on `Server`) or use atomic counters.
